# Rooftop Heroes

> Rooftop Heroes LLC is a licensed and insured residential roofing company in Ann Arbor, Michigan (MI Builder License #262600515), serving Washtenaw County, western Wayne County, Livingston County and select Oakland County communities. Services: roof replacement, new roof installation, roof repair and storm damage assessment, gutters, attic insulation and ventilation. Free roof inspections with written estimates, instant online roof quotes, and financing. Owens Corning Preferred Contractor; certified with GAF and CertainTeed. Rated 5.0 on Google.

- Office: 3027 Miller Rd, Suite 11, Ann Arbor, MI 48103
- Phone: (734) 201-1000
- Email: info@rooftopheroes.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 4:00pm
